params.body:
When gentells.com answered a signed call with a page instead of JSON (the pre-launch cover in front of `/internal/commitments`), `callSite` passed the 200 through with an error object. `/site/commitments` then turned that into an empty list, and the Deliveries page said "Nothing is due" when gentells.com had not answered at all.

`callSite` now returns 502 "The site answered with a page, not data" when a 2xx reply is not JSON. A failed reply that is not JSON keeps its status, as before. Both relays (accounts and deliveries) go through `callSite`, so both show an error instead of an empty page.

The site side of the fix is in gentells-site (the cover and CSRF lists).

Tests: `test/commitments-relay.test.mjs` (a new case for a page answered with a 200), `site-accounts` and `account-delete`, 17 of 17 passing.
params.title: Take a page from gentells.com for no answer, not for data
